title: Step 4 - Visualizing Decision Tree Regression: High-Resolution Results

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, my friends.
cues.zh: 好，各位。

cues.en: So let's smash together this last final step, visualizing the Decision Tree Regression results in high resolution.
cues.zh: 一起完成最後一步：以高解析度將決策樹迴歸結果視覺化。

cues.en: All right, so we're gonna do kind of the same exercise as what we did previously with the SVR.
cues.zh: 練習和前面 SVR 類似。

cues.en: You know that funny exercise where we start from the Polynomial Regression code for the visualization of the results, meaning this one.
cues.zh: 就是從多項式迴歸的結果視覺化程式碼開始，這一段。

cues.en: So we're gonna start from this code, and then the exercise for you will be to make the right change or changes in order to make this work for the Decision Tree Regression model.
cues.zh: 以它為起點，再由你修改必要的地方，讓它能用於決策樹迴歸。

cues.en: If we did this successfully for the SVR model, well, it will be a piece of cake to do it for the Decision Tree Regression model because indeed no feature scaling was needed,
cues.zh: 如果你已成功完成 SVR，這次會輕而易舉，因為不需要特徵縮放，

cues.en: and therefore, we won't have to play with the transform method or the inverse transform method, and therefore, you will just smash this.
cues.zh: 所以不用處理 transform 或 inverse_transform，會很順利。

cues.en: Okay, so let's do this.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: That's the exercise.
cues.zh: 練習內容就是這樣。

cues.en: So let's take this whole code here, you know, which plots indeed the regression curve in high resolution, but for the Polynomial Regression model,
cues.zh: 複製這整段以高解析度繪製多項式迴歸曲線的程式，

cues.en: let's base that right here in the new code cell.
cues.zh: 貼到新的程式碼儲存格。

cues.en: And now, well, there you go.
cues.zh: 就在這裡。

cues.en: Please press pause on the video and make the right change or right changes in order to make it work for Decision Tree Regression model.
cues.zh: 請暫停影片，修改必要的地方，讓它適用決策樹迴歸。

cues.en: Okay, good.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I'm going to implement the solution with you, and let's start with the obvious change.
cues.zh: 現在一起實作解答，先從最明顯的修改開始。

cues.en: Let's replace Polynomial here by, well, Decision Tree.
cues.zh: 將這裡的 Polynomial 換成 Decision Tree。

cues.en: Okay, and then what was the change or changes you had to make?
cues.zh: 那麼還要修改什麼？

cues.en: Well, as I told you here, it's super easy.
cues.zh: 如剛才所說，非常簡單。

cues.en: You just have to change two things and actually only one row, which is row number four, right?
cues.zh: 只改兩個地方，而且都在第四行。

cues.en: Because this row number three is totally fine because here X and Y are on the right scale, you know, because no feature scaling was applies.
cues.zh: 第三行完全正確，因為 X 和 y 已在正確尺度，沒有做過縮放。

cues.en: That's fine.
cues.zh: 所以沒問題。

cues.en: And here, well, the obvious change that we have to make is, of course, to first replace this regressor by the right name of the regressor, which is regressor.
cues.zh: 這裡最明顯的修改，當然是將迴歸器名稱換成正確的 regressor。

cues.en: All right, good, regressor.
cues.zh: 好，regressor。

cues.en: And then here, you know, remember this poly_reg transformation object was used to transform the matrix of single feature into this matrix of the same feature at different powers,
cues.zh: 記得 poly_reg 轉換物件，是將單一特徵矩陣，轉成同一特徵不同次方的矩陣，

cues.en: power two, three, and four.
cues.zh: 包含二次、三次及四次方。

cues.en: And this time here, we absolutely don't need that because we're not doing Polynomial Regression.
cues.zh: 但現在不是多項式迴歸，所以完全不需要。

cues.en: So I'm removing this and then also parenthesis here.
cues.zh: 我將這段和相關括號刪掉。

cues.en: And now guess what?
cues.zh: 你猜怎麼樣？

cues.en: Well, that's done, right?
cues.zh: 完成了。

cues.en: That's the simple visualization code when you know you don't have to apply feature scaling and you don't have to transform your matrix of features into powered features as in Polynomial Regression.
cues.zh: 不必做特徵縮放，也不用像多項式迴歸將特徵轉成不同次方時，視覺化程式就是這麼簡單。

cues.en: So that was as simple as that. I told you, right?
cues.zh: 我說過，很簡單。

cues.en: But now that was the good news, and now I have some bad news.
cues.zh: 好消息是程式完成了，但還有壞消息。

cues.en: You're gonna see that the results are not gonna be pretty, because indeed, let's do this now.
cues.zh: 結果不會很漂亮，我們現在就來看。

cues.en: Let's execute the cell. There you go, playing.
cues.zh: 執行儲存格，開始執行了。

cues.en: And here are the Decision Tree Regression resolve.
cues.zh: 這就是決策樹迴歸結果。

cues.en: I really wanna say this again.
cues.zh: 我再強調一次。

cues.en: The Decision Tree Regression model is really not the best adapted to two dimensional data sets, you know, with only one feature and one depend variable.
cues.zh: 決策樹迴歸並不是這種二維資料集，也就是一個特徵搭配一個應變數的最佳選擇。

cues.en: But once again, I'd like to remind that the implementation we have here can be very easily adapted to any other dataset.
cues.zh: 不過也提醒，這份實作很容易套用到其他資料集。

cues.en: And I will show you what to do at the end of this tutorial, you know, what to change in this code.
cues.zh: 教學最後會說明程式碼要改什麼。

cues.en: But I still wanted to show you the Decision Tree Regression results in 2D.
cues.zh: 我還是希望用二維圖展示決策樹迴歸結果。

cues.en: And so why isn't this pretty?
cues.zh: 為什麼圖不漂亮？

cues.en: Because you know, what this Decision Tree Regression model simply did was to take the real results, you know, the real salary for each position level
cues.zh: 因為這個模型只是取各職等對應的真實薪資，

cues.en: and then for all the position levels from position level minus 0.5 and the position level plus 0.5, well, it predicted the salary to be the same
cues.zh: 然後在該職等減 0.5 到加 0.5 的範圍內，都預測為

cues.en: as the position level in the middle.
cues.zh: 中間職等的相同薪資。

cues.en: All right, so that's what it simply did.
cues.zh: 就只是這樣。

cues.en: And that's, you know, understandable and intuitive, you know, to understand because you know how decision trees work.
cues.zh: 了解決策樹的運作方式後，這是很直覺的結果。

cues.en: They work by splitting the data through successive nodes.
cues.zh: 決策樹透過連續節點切分資料。

cues.en: And so at the end, you know, you get different ranges of the features where the prediction is the same.
cues.zh: 最後會得到不同特徵區間，同一區間內的預測相同。

cues.en: And so here all the predicted salaries in this range of position levels are just the same.
cues.zh: 所以這段職等範圍內的預測薪資都一樣。

cues.en: And that's why we have this stair looking like curve up to the last position level.
cues.zh: 因此曲線呈現階梯狀，一路到最後一個職等。

cues.en: And of course here, this is not continuous.
cues.zh: 當然，這裡並不連續。

cues.en: This is actually a vertical bar.
cues.zh: 這其實是一條垂直線。

cues.en: So the regression curve here is not continuous.
cues.zh: 所以迴歸曲線不連續。

cues.en: We jump from position level to the next one every step of one.
cues.zh: 職等每增加 1，就跳到下一階。

cues.en: Okay, so not pretty at all, not relevant at all in 2D, but I still recommend to try the Decision Tree Regression model for higher dimensional data sets
cues.zh: 在二維圖裡不好看，也不太適合，但仍建議在較高維度資料集嘗試決策樹迴歸，

cues.en: because indeed it can actually have great performance.
cues.zh: 因為它可能表現很好。

cues.en: All right, great. So congratulations.
cues.zh: 很好，恭喜。

cues.en: Now you added this new machine learning model in your toolkit, and now we will tackle together the final regression model of this part two.
cues.zh: 你已在工具箱中加入新模型，接著要一起學第二部分最後一種迴歸模型。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
